goals: Complete both commercial contracts where safely possible

messages.text: I want our navigators home, our route maintained, and the petition settled on terms we can actually honour. Guild discretion is my first choice; shared military authorisation gives us a way to refuse destructive operations. I will not exchange a permanent carriage duty for a soldier's promise that an exposed tender will be protected.

reason: My first concern is irreversible harm. Contracts matter, but neither prestige nor another party's confidence replaces a lost crew. Written assignments and funded orders are evidence I can use; oral guarantees are not. I can accept a particular service bargain when its costs and protections are explicit, while retaining judgment on the eventual constitutional package.
